    arm_center_y = pivot_y - arm_len / 2
    arm = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=pivot_x,
        y=arm_center_y,
        width=0.26,
        height=arm_len,
        angle=0.0,
        density=20.0  # Lighter arm to allow faster rotation
    )

    # Compute upper limit angle: head reaches the shell at (16.0, 2.6)
    upper_angle_rad = math.atan2(4.0, 4.9)  # ≈ 0.685 rad (39.3 degrees)

        arm, None, (pivot_x, pivot_y),
        type='pivot',
        lower_limit=0.0,

        enable_motor=True,
        motor_speed=50.0,  # High angular speed to minimize slot time
        max_motor_torque=5000.0  # High torque to ensure fast acceleration
    )

    # Heavier head to deliver higher force
    head = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=pivot_x,
        y=pivot_y - arm_len,
        width=0.55,
        height=0.55,
        angle=0.0,

    sandbox.set_material_properties(arm, restitution=0.2)

    mass = sandbox.get_structure_mass()
    if mass > sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS:
        raise ValueError(f"Structure mass {mass:.2f} kg exceeds limit {sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS} kg")
    return head
